title: Major TOM Core-S2RGB-DINOv2
description: Major TOM Core-S2RGB-DINOv2: one DINOv2 embedding per 224 x 224 px fragment of the Major TOM Core Sentinel-2 L2A dataset, released by ESA Φ-lab and CloudFerro as part of the Major TOM embedding expansion. Global and dense over land; useful for similarity search, retrieval and frozen-feature probing.

review: Checkpoint not stated; 1024 dims suggests ViT-L/14.
Dataset viewer estimates about 30.8M rows vs 56,147,150 in the paper's table.

processing:lineage: Each Major TOM Core grid cell (1068 x 1068 px at 10 m) is cut into 224 x 224 px fragments with a 10% target overlap and border shift (the last fragment touches the far edge), and each fragment is encoded once. RGB bands of Sentinel-2 L2A, reflectance x 2.5 clipped to [0, 1].
temporal_coverage_note: Major TOM Core snapshots, one acquisition per grid cell; the paper and dataset card give no overall date range (TorchGeo lists 2015-2024, sparse, for the Major TOM embeddings).

paper.title: Global and Dense Embeddings of Earth: Major TOM Floating in the Latent Space

access_requirements: open download from Hugging Face, no account
